name: Nomic Embed Text v2 MoE
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder (nomic_bert with MoE), full attention, no causal mask
notes: MoE embedding model: 8 experts, top_k 2, moe_every_n_layers 2 (so 6 of 12 layers are MoE). Total params 494M but active params only ~58M per token — this is the key serving advantage. At 58M active params, flops_per_token_active is ~1.16e8, comparable to bge-small (33M) but with the capacity of a much larger model. Matryoshka-trained: supports dimension truncation. Vocab 250048 (multilingual). Apache-2.0. GGUF and ONNX ports exist.
